rubriker.title: Review: The Petroff Defence - Fight for More Than Equality by GM Fabien Libiszewski
rubriker._rss_content: For a long time, the Petroff Defence had a reputation for being a purely drawish opening – reliable but dry. Those days are over, however. In a ChessBase video course, Grandmaster Fabien Libiszewski demonstrates how modern players can turn this old reputation to their psychological advantage. Christian Höthe took a close look at the course. | Photos: ChessBase

rubriker.title: Who will become the FIDE World Combined Champion?
rubriker._rss_content: The Total Chess World Championship series is a new tournament format combining three different time controls: fast classic, rapid and blitz. The winner of the series will be crowned the FIDE World Combined Champion. Both the winner and the runner-up will then qualify for the Candidates Tournament for the classical World Championship. How did this format come about? | Photo: Michal Walusza / Norway Chess

rubriker.title: Speed Chess Championship Celebrates 10 Years
rubriker._rss_content: The Speed Chess Championship marks ten years with a $250,000 edition and live finals in London in February. Firouzja has already qualified.

rubriker.title: Begmuratov and Roebers Win the World Junior Rapid Titles
rubriker._rss_content: Begmuratov wins the World Junior Rapid open title unbeaten, and top seed Eline Roebers takes the girls crown in Al Ain after strong finishes.

rubriker.title: FIDE Renewing Its Trust In Sutovsky
rubriker._rss_content: FIDE names Emil Sutovsky CEO of its Swiss commercial arm, FIDE Enterprises, alongside his adviser role to Turlov.
